comparison.objective: Compress and fit a spring tension rod between cupboard walls at a marked level; candidate separates media from washers.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual rod compression, endpoint placement against opposed walls, and controlled release under spring preload versus pouring and agitation of granular contents in a screen.
comparison.success_condition: Rod must self-support with both caps pressing the walls, lie within the height band and level/square tolerances, remain clear of the table, and hold for 4 s after release. Candidate requires ≥98% media recovery, all washers retained, no loss/damage, and 3 s supported release. No material rubric detail is missing.
comparison.reason: Opposed spring-force installation and geometric placement do not test selective granular passage.
